# File operations: ls, cp, mv, rm, mkdir, rmdir, ln, touch, stat-free
# checks, basename, dirname, readlink, realpath, du.

ls
ls -a dir
ls -l
ls -la dir/sub
ls -R dir
ls -1 -F
ls -d dir dir/sub
ls -S
ls -r -t
ls missing a.txt
ls -m dir
ls -x -w 30
ls -i empty >/dev/null; echo $?
cp a.txt c.txt && cat c.txt
cp -r dir copy && ls -R copy
cp dir x
cp missing x
cp -v a.txt b.txt dir
cp -n a.txt b.txt; cat b.txt
cp a.txt a.txt
mv a.txt moved && ls
mv -v b.txt dir/ && ls dir
mv missing x
mv dir dir/sub
rm a.txt && ls
rm missing
rm -f missing; echo $?
rm dir
rm -r dir && ls
rm -d dir
rm -rv dir | sort
rm -i a.txt < /dev/null
rm .
rm -r /
rmdir dir
rmdir -p dir/sub
mkdir new && ls -d new
mkdir -p deep/er/est && ls -R deep
mkdir dir
mkdir -v x y
mkdir -m 700 private && ls -ld private | cut -c1-10
ln -s a.txt sym && readlink sym
ln a.txt hard && ls -l hard | cut -c1-12
ln a.txt b.txt
ln -sf b.txt link && readlink link
touch new && ls new
touch -c ghost; ls ghost
touch -d '2001-02-03 04:05:06' a.txt && ls -l --time-style=full-iso a.txt
basename /usr/lib/file.tar.gz .gz
basename -a /x/a /y/b
basename -s .txt a.txt b.txt
dirname /usr/lib/ a/b c
readlink link
readlink -f link
readlink -f dir/../a.txt
readlink a.txt; echo $?
realpath link dir/sub
realpath -e missing
realpath -m missing/x
du -s dir
du -a dir | sort -k2
du -sh dir
du -c a.txt b.txt
du missing
